email.subject: DK quantity mismatch — US67066G1040, 19 November 2026
email.body:
Hello,

Please confirm that DTC participant 0005 is correct for this equity delivery. Our client amended the allocation from 8,000 to 10,000 shares; the amendment is currently in repair.

Once we confirm the participant and the amended instruction is live at DTC, please redeliver 10,000 shares of US67066G1040 for $1,862,600 to participant 0901. The DK’d delivery reference is DTC-DO-20261119-000318.

Thank you.
